RUS_np_refresh_rural_state = {
	set_state_flag = RUS_np_rural_area
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rural_build_speed = PREV.RUS_np_rural_build_speed }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rural_slots = PREV.RUS_np_rural_slots }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { infrastructure < 5 } }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_rural_build_speed = 0.1 }
	set_state_flag = RUS_np_rural_infra_five
}
	else = {
	clr_state_flag = RUS_np_rural_infra_five
}
	if = {
	limit = { OR = { check_variable = { RUS_np_rural_build_speed < 0 } check_variable = { RUS_np_rural_slots < 0 } } }
	if = {
	limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_rural_infrastructure_improved } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_rural_infrastructure_improved }
}
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_rural_infrastructure } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_rural_infrastructure }
}
}
	else = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_rural_infrastructure } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_rural_infrastructure }
}
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_rural_infrastructure_improved } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_rural_infrastructure_improved }
}
}
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}
RUS_np_refresh_rural = {
	if = {
	limit = { original_tag = RUS has_country_flag = RUS_np_rural_enabled }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rural_score = 0 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_variable = RUS_first_five_year_plan_score }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rural_score = RUS_first_five_year_plan_score }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_rural_score < 0 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rural_score = 0 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_rural_score > 150 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rural_score = 150 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rural_build_speed = RUS_np_rural_score }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_rural_build_speed = 150 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_rural_build_speed = 0.25 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_rural_build_speed = 0.2 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rural_slots = RUS_np_rural_score }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_rural_slots = 150 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_rural_slots = 0.175 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_rural_slots = 0.15 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rural_scan_age = global.num_days }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_rural_scan_age = RUS_np_rural_scan_day }
	if = {
	limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_rural_cached_score } NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_np_rural_score = RUS_np_rural_cached_score } } check_variable = { RUS_np_rural_scan_age > 29 } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rural_cached_score = RUS_np_rural_score }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rural_scan_day = global.num_days }
	every_owned_state = {
	limit = { OR = { has_state_flag = RUS_np_rural_area RUS_np_rural_candidate = yes } }
	RUS_np_refresh_rural_state = yes
}
}
}
}

	RUS_np_refresh_rural = yes

	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_rural_enabled check_variable = { RUS_np_rural_infra_day < global.num_days } }

	limit = { has_state_flag = RUS_np_rural_area OR = { AND = { NOT = { infrastructure < 5 } NOT = { has_state_flag = RUS_np_rural_infra_five } } AND = { infrastructure < 5 has_state_flag = RUS_np_rural_infra_five } } }
	RUS_np_refresh_rural_state = yes
}

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_transport_bonus = 0.01 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_leningrad_dispatch > 0 } 195 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } has_railway_connection = { start_state = 219 target_state = 195 } }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_transport_bonus = 0.01 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_tsaritsyn_dispatch > 0 } 217 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } has_railway_connection = { start_state = 219 target_state = 217 } }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_transport_bonus = 0.01 }
}
	if = {

	else = {

	RUS_np_refresh = yes
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes

	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 219 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.75 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.499 }

	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = RUS_np_return_trains }
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_kamenev_all_russian_electrification_running
	set_variable = { RUS_np_kamenev_all_russian_electrification_trains = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_kamenev_all_russian_electrification_paid = 0 }
	RUS_np_refresh = yes
	set_country_flag = RUS_rc_settled_RUS_kamenev_all_russian_electrification
	clr_country_flag = RUS_rc_running_RUS_kamenev_all_russian_electrification
}

RUS_np_kamenev_all_russian_electrification_cancel = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_kamenev_all_russian_electrification_running }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_kamenev_all_russian_electrification_total }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_kamenev_all_russian_electrification_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_kamenev_all_russian_electrification_total }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_kamenev_all_russian_electrification_paid }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_kamenev_all_russian_electrification_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 219 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_loss = RUS_np_refund }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_loss = 0.5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_loss }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_loss }
}
	RUS_np_kamenev_all_russian_electrification_release = yes
}
}
RUS_np_kamenev_all_russian_electrification_finish = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_kamenev_all_russian_electrification_running }
	RUS_np_kamenev_all_russian_electrification_tick = yes
	if = {
	limit = { 219 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } }
	RUS_np_kamenev_all_russian_electrification_goals = yes

			log = "[GetLogRoot]: Decision removed RUS_kamenev_all_russian_electrification"
			custom_effect_tooltip = RUS_kamenev_all_russian_electrification_complete_tt
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_tesla_electrification_chance_active }
				custom_effect_tooltip = RUS_tesla_all_russian_electrification_chance_tt
			}
			hidden_effect = {

				clr_country_flag = RUS_kamenev_all_russian_electrification_in_progress
				random_owned_controlled_state = {
					limit = {
						is_core_of = ROOT
						infrastructure < 5
					}
					add_building_construction = {
						type = infrastructure
						level = 1
						instant_build = yes
					}
					if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_building_construction = {
						type = infrastructure
						level = 1
						instant_build = yes
					} } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
					add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
					if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1 } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
					if = {
						limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_tesla_electrification_chance_active } }
						random_list = {
							25 = {
								if = {
									limit = {
										energy_infrastructure < 1
										industrial_infrastructure < 1
									}
									add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
									if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1 } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD

RUS_np_magnitogorsk_timer = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_magnitogorsk_running has_variable = RUS_np_magnitogorsk_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_magnitogorsk_display = 0 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_np_magnitogorsk_left < 0.001 } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_magnitogorsk_display = RUS_np_magnitogorsk_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_magnitogorsk_display = RUS_np_speed }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_magnitogorsk_display = RUS_np_transport_duration_4 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_magnitogorsk_display = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_magnitogorsk_display
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_magnitogorsk_display < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_magnitogorsk_display = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_magnitogorsk_display > 7300 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_magnitogorsk_display = 7300 }
}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_magnitogorsk_display = 1 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_magnitogorsk_display }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_magnitogorsk_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_magnitogorsk_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_magnitogorsk_deadline = RUS_np_magnitogorsk_display }
	RUS_np_magnitogorsk_apply_timer_delta = yes
}

RUS_np_magnitogorsk_tick = {

	RUS_np_magnitogorsk_goals = yes

	divide_variable = { RUS_np_regional_work = RUS_np_transport_duration_4 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_magnitogorsk_left = RUS_np_regional_work }

	set_variable = { RUS_np_magnitogorsk_left = 0 }

			RUS_stalin_industry_effect = yes

 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_BEGIN

 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_END

	RUS_np_flush_plan_score = yes
	if = {

	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }

	round_variable = RUS_np_second_baku_display

	set_variable = { RUS_np_second_baku_display = 1 }

	if = {

	RUS_np_second_baku_goals = yes

			log = "[GetLogRoot][GetLogFrom]: Decision remove RUS_second_baku"
			if = {
				limit = { has_idea = vostokneft_improved }

					}

						amount = 24
					} } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
				}
			}
			else = {
				651 = {
					add_resource = {
						type = oil
						amount = 20
					}
					if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_resource = {
						type = oil
						amount = 20
					} } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
				}
			}
			RUS_stalin_industry_effect = yes

 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_BEGIN
 hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = RUS_rc_finished_RUS_second_baku set_country_flag = RUS_rc_settled_RUS_second_baku clr_country_flag = RUS_rc_running_RUS_second_baku  }
 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_END

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 4 }
	if = {

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 1 }
}

}

}
}
}
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_second_baku_completed
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_second_baku_paid }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_625 has_country_flag = RUS_np_second_baku_goal_1 has_country_flag = RUS_np_second_baku_goal_2 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.5 }
}
	else = {

	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_second_baku_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	RUS_np_second_baku_release = yes
}
	else = {
	RUS_np_second_baku_cancel = yes
}

	set_variable = { RUS_np_chelyabinsk_tractor_plant_display = 7300 }
}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_chelyabinsk_tractor_plant_display = 1 }

	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_chelyabinsk_tractor_plant_deadline }

RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_timer = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_running has_variable = RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_display = 0 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_left < 0.001 } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_display = RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_display = RUS_np_speed }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_display = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_display
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_display < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_display = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_display > 7300 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_display = 7300 }
}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_display = 1 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_display }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_deadline = RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_display }
	RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_apply_timer_delta = yes
}
}

	set_variable = { RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_trains = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_paid = 0 }
	RUS_np_refresh = yes
	set_country_flag = RUS_rc_settled_RUS_kursk_tractor_plant
	clr_country_flag = RUS_rc_running_RUS_kursk_tractor_plant

	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 220 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_loss = RUS_np_refund }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_loss = 0.5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_loss }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_loss }
}
	RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_release = yes
}

RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_finish = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_running }
	RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_tick = yes
	if = {
	limit = { 220 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } }
	RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_goals = yes

			log = "[GetLogRoot][GetLogFrom]: Decision remove RUS_kursk_tractor_plant"
			220 = {
				add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2
				if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
				add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 2 }
				if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 2 } } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
				add_victory_points = { province = 3580 value = 3 }
			}
			RUS_stalin_industry_effect = yes

 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_BEGIN
 hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = RUS_rc_finished_RUS_kursk_tractor_plant set_country_flag = RUS_rc_settled_RUS_kursk_tractor_plant clr_country_flag = RUS_rc_running_RUS_kursk_tractor_plant  }
 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_END

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 4 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_182 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 1 }
}
	RUS_np_flush_plan_score = yes
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_goal_1 }
	220 = {
	hidden_effect = { if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }
} }
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_goal_2 }
	custom_effect_tooltip = RUS_np_farm_credit_tt
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { RUS_np_farm_credit = 100 } }
}
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_completed
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_paid }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_625 has_country_flag = RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_goal_1 has_country_flag = RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_goal_2 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.5 }
}
	else = {
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_release = yes
}
	else = {
	RUS_np_kursk_tractor_plant_cancel = yes
}
}

RUS_np_rostselmash_begin = {
	if = {
	limit = { RUS_np_ready_rostselmash = yes }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_total = 60 }

	limit = { has_variable = RUS_ic_time_60 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_total = RUS_ic_time_60 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_total < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_total = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_total > 3650 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_total = 3650 }
}

	set_country_flag = RUS_np_rostselmash_running

	limit = { has_idea = RUS_disordered_industry_federal }

	if = {
	limit = { has_variable = RUS_np_rostselmash_budget_current }

	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_available = RUS_np_rostselmash_paid }

	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_rostselmash_goal_2

}
}

RUS_np_rostselmash_timer = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_rostselmash_running has_variable = RUS_np_rostselmash_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_display = 0 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_left < 0.001 } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_display = RUS_np_rostselmash_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_display = RUS_np_speed }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_display = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_rostselmash_display
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_display < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_display = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_display > 7300 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_display = 7300 }
}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_display = 1 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_rostselmash_display }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_rostselmash_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_deadline = RUS_np_rostselmash_display }
	RUS_np_rostselmash_apply_timer_delta = yes
}
}
RUS_np_rostselmash_tick = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_rostselmash_running check_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_last_day < global.num_days } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_last_day = global.num_days }
	RUS_np_rostselmash_goals = yes
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_left = RUS_np_speed }
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_left < 0 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_left = 0 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_left > RUS_np_rostselmash_total } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_left = RUS_np_rostselmash_total }
}
}
}
RUS_np_rostselmash_release = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_rostselmash_running }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_frozen = RUS_np_rostselmash_paid }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_available = RUS_np_refund }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_spent = RUS_np_consumed }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = RUS_np_rostselmash_trains }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 218 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.75 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_return_trains
}
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = RUS_np_return_trains }
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_rostselmash_running
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_rostselmash_cost }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_trains = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rostselmash_paid = 0 }
	RUS_np_refresh = yes
	set_country_flag = RUS_rc_settled_RUS_rostselmash
	clr_country_flag = RUS_rc_running_RUS_rostselmash
}
}
RUS_np_rostselmash_cancel = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_rostselmash_running }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_rostselmash_total }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_rostselmash_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_rostselmash_total }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_rostselmash_paid }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_rostselmash_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 218 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_loss = RUS_np_refund }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_loss = 0.5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_loss }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_loss }
}
	RUS_np_rostselmash_release = yes
}
}
RUS_np_rostselmash_finish = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_rostselmash_running }
	RUS_np_rostselmash_tick = yes
	if = {
	limit = { 218 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } }
	RUS_np_rostselmash_goals = yes

			log = "[GetLogRoot][GetLogFrom]: Decision remove RUS_rostselmash"
			218 = {
				add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2
				if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
				add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 2 }
				if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 2 } } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
				add_resource = {
					type = steel
					amount = 10
				}
				if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_resource = {
					type = steel
					amount = 10
				} } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
			}
			RUS_stalin_industry_effect = yes

 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_BEGIN
 hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = RUS_rc_finished_RUS_rostselmash set_country_flag = RUS_rc_settled_RUS_rostselmash clr_country_flag = RUS_rc_running_RUS_rostselmash  }
 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_END

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 4 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_182 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 1 }
}
	RUS_np_flush_plan_score = yes
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_rostselmash_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_rostselmash_goal_1 }
	218 = {
	hidden_effect = { if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }
} }
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_rostselmash_goal_2 }
	custom_effect_tooltip = RUS_np_farm_credit_tt
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { RUS_np_farm_credit = 100 } }
	RUS_np_award_land_score = yes
}
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_rostselmash_completed
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_rostselmash_paid }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_625 has_country_flag = RUS_np_rostselmash_goal_1 has_country_flag = RUS_np_rostselmash_goal_2 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.5 }
}
	else = {

}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_rostselmash_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	RUS_np_rostselmash_release = yes
}
	else = {
	RUS_np_rostselmash_cancel = yes
}
}

RUS_np_stavropol_hydroelectric_dam_finish = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_stavropol_hydroelectric_dam_running }

	if = {
	limit = { 235 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } }
	RUS_np_stavropol_hydroelectric_dam_goals = yes

			log = "[GetLogRoot][GetLogFrom]: Decision remove RUS_stavropol_hydroelectric_dam"

			# RUS_EASY_MODE_TECH_START
			if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } add_tech_bonus = {
				name = RUS_industrialise_eastern_europe
				bonus = 2
				uses = 1
				category = industry
			} }
			else = { add_tech_bonus = {
				name = RUS_industrialise_eastern_europe
				bonus = 1
				uses = 1
				category = industry
			} }
			# RUS_EASY_MODE_TECH_END

			235 = {
				add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 5
				if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 5 } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
				add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 }
				if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 } } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
				add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 2 }
				if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 2 } } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
				add_victory_points = { province = 748 value = 3 }
				custom_effect_tooltip = tooltip_white_line
				add_building_construction = {
					type = dam
					level = 1
					province = 731
					instant_build = yes
				}
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = {
				localization_key = building_state_modifier|dam
				INDENT = "    "
			}
			RUS_decrease_black_monday = yes
			RUS_stalin_industry_effect = yes

 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_BEGIN
 hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = RUS_rc_finished_RUS_stavropol_hydroelectric_dam set_country_flag = RUS_rc_settled_RUS_stavropol_hydroelectric_dam clr_country_flag = RUS_rc_running_RUS_stavropol_hydroelectric_dam  }
 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_END

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 6 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_182 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 1 }
}
	RUS_np_flush_plan_score = yes
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_stavropol_hydroelectric_dam_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_stavropol_hydroelectric_dam_goal_1 }
	235 = {
	hidden_effect = { if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }
} }
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_stavropol_hydroelectric_dam_goal_2 }
	235 = {
	if = {
	limit = { industrial_infrastructure < 5 }
	add_building_construction = { type = industrial_infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}
}
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_stavropol_hydroelectric_dam_completed
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_stavropol_hydroelectric_dam_paid }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_625 has_country_flag = RUS_np_stavropol_hydroelectric_dam_goal_1 has_country_flag = RUS_np_stavropol_hydroelectric_dam_goal_2 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.5 }
}
	else = {
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_stavropol_hydroelectric_dam_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	RUS_np_stavropol_hydroelectric_dam_release = yes
}
	else = {
	RUS_np_stavropol_hydroelectric_dam_cancel = yes
}
}
}

				}
			}

				localization_key = building_state_modifier|dam
				INDENT = "    "
			}
			RUS_decrease_black_monday = yes
			RUS_stalin_industry_effect = yes

 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_BEGIN
 hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = RUS_rc_finished_RUS_rybinsk_hydroelectric_dam set_country_flag = RUS_rc_settled_RUS_rybinsk_hydroelectric_dam clr_country_flag = RUS_rc_running_RUS_rybinsk_hydroelectric_dam  }
 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_END

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 6 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_182 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 1 }
}
	RUS_np_flush_plan_score = yes
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_rybinsk_hydroelectric_dam_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_rybinsk_hydroelectric_dam_goal_1 }
	248 = {
	hidden_effect = { if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }
} }
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_rybinsk_hydroelectric_dam_goal_2 }

	add_building_construction = { type = industrial_infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {

}
}
}
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_rybinsk_hydroelectric_dam_completed
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_rybinsk_hydroelectric_dam_paid }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_625 has_country_flag = RUS_np_rybinsk_hydroelectric_dam_goal_1 has_country_flag = RUS_np_rybinsk_hydroelectric_dam_goal_2 }

}
	else = {

}

	RUS_np_rybinsk_hydroelectric_dam_release = yes

	else = {
	RUS_np_rybinsk_hydroelectric_dam_cancel = yes
}

RUS_np_uralmash_timer = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_uralmash_running has_variable = RUS_np_uralmash_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_uralmash_display = 0 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_np_uralmash_left < 0.001 } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_uralmash_display = RUS_np_uralmash_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_uralmash_display = RUS_np_speed }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_uralmash_display = RUS_np_transport_duration_4 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_uralmash_display = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_uralmash_display
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_uralmash_display < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_uralmash_display = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_uralmash_display > 7300 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_uralmash_display = 7300 }
}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_uralmash_display = 1 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_uralmash_display }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_uralmash_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_uralmash_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_uralmash_deadline = RUS_np_uralmash_display }
	RUS_np_uralmash_apply_timer_delta = yes
}

RUS_np_uralmash_tick = {

	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_uralmash_left < 0 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_uralmash_left = 0 }

	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_uralmash_left > RUS_np_uralmash_total } }

}

	limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_left < 0.001 } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_display = RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_display = RUS_np_speed }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_display = RUS_np_transport_duration_4 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_display = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_display
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_display < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_display = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_display > 7300 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_display = 7300 }
}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_display = 1 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_display }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_deadline = global.num_days }

	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }

	set_variable = { RUS_np_loss = RUS_np_refund }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_loss = 0.5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_loss }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_loss }
}
	RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_release = yes
}

RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_finish = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_running }
	RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_tick = yes
	if = {
	limit = { 398 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } }
	RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_goals = yes

			log = "[GetLogRoot][GetLogFrom]: Decision remove RUS_motovilikha_plants"
			398 = {
				add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2
				if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
				add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 }
				if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 } } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
				add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 1 }
				if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 1 } } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
			}
			RUS_stalin_industry_effect = yes

 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_BEGIN
 hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = RUS_rc_finished_RUS_motovilikha_plants set_country_flag = RUS_rc_settled_RUS_motovilikha_plants clr_country_flag = RUS_rc_running_RUS_motovilikha_plants  }
 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_END

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 4 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_182 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 1 }
}
	RUS_np_flush_plan_score = yes
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_goal_1 }
	398 = {
	hidden_effect = { if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }
} }
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_goal_2 }
	398 = {
	if = {
	limit = { industrial_infrastructure < 5 }
	add_building_construction = { type = industrial_infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}
}
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_completed
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_paid }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_625 has_country_flag = RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_goal_1 has_country_flag = RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_goal_2 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.5 }
}
	else = {
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_release = yes
}
	else = {
	RUS_np_motovilikha_plants_cancel = yes
}
}
}

RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_timer = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_running has_variable = RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_display = 0 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_left < 0.001 } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_display = RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_display = RUS_np_speed }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_display = RUS_np_transport_duration_2 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_display = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_display
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_display < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_display = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_display > 7300 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_display = 7300 }
}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_display = 1 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_display }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_deadline = RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_display }
	RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_apply_timer_delta = yes
}
}
RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_tick = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_running check_variable = { RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_last_day < global.num_days } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_last_day = global.num_days }
	RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_goals = yes
	set_variable = { RUS_np_regional_work = RUS_np_speed }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_regional_work = RUS_np_transport_duration_2 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_left = RUS_np_regional_work }
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_left < 0 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_left = 0 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_left > RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_total } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_left = RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_total }
}
}
}
RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_release = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_running }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_frozen = RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_paid }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_available = RUS_np_refund }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_spent = RUS_np_consumed }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_trains }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 137 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.75 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_return_trains
}
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = RUS_np_return_trains }
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_running
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_cost }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_trains = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_paid = 0 }
	RUS_np_refresh = yes
	set_country_flag = RUS_rc_settled_RUS_admiralty_dockyards
	clr_country_flag = RUS_rc_running_RUS_admiralty_dockyards
}
}
RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_cancel = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_running }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_total }

	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_paid }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }

	limit = { NOT = { 137 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_loss = RUS_np_refund }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_loss = 0.5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_loss }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_loss }
}
	RUS_np_admiralty_dockyards_release = yes
}

 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_BEGIN
 hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = RUS_rc_finished_RUS_admiralty_dockyards set_country_flag = RUS_rc_settled_RUS_admiralty_dockyards clr_country_flag = RUS_rc_running_RUS_admiralty_dockyards  }
 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_END

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 4 }

	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }

	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }

	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }

	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_arctic_mines_running }
	RUS_np_arctic_mines_tick = yes
	if = {
	limit = { 213 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } 722 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } }
	RUS_np_arctic_mines_goals = yes

			log = "[GetLogRoot][GetLogFrom]: Decision remove RUS_arctic_mines"
			213 = {
				add_resource = {
					type = steel
					amount = 8
				}
				if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_resource = {
					type = steel
					amount = 8
				} } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
			}
			722 = {
				add_resource = {
					type = chromium
					amount = 20
				}
				if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_resource = {
					type = chromium
					amount = 20
				} } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
			}
			RUS_stalin_industry_effect = yes

 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_BEGIN
 hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = RUS_rc_finished_RUS_arctic_mines set_country_flag = RUS_rc_settled_RUS_arctic_mines clr_country_flag = RUS_rc_running_RUS_arctic_mines  }
 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_END

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 2 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_182 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 1 }
}
	RUS_np_flush_plan_score = yes
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_arctic_mines_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_arctic_mines_goal_1 }
	213 = {
	add_resource = { type = steel amount = 4 }
}
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_arctic_mines_goal_2 }
	213 = {
	if = {
	limit = { industrial_infrastructure < 5 }
	add_building_construction = { type = industrial_infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}
}
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_arctic_mines_completed
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_arctic_mines_paid }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_625 has_country_flag = RUS_np_arctic_mines_goal_1 has_country_flag = RUS_np_arctic_mines_goal_2 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.5 }
}
	else = {
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_arctic_mines_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	RUS_np_arctic_mines_release = yes
}
	else = {
	RUS_np_arctic_mines_cancel = yes
}
}
}
RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_begin = {
	if = {
	limit = { RUS_np_ready_tyrnyauz_tungsten = yes }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_total = 60 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_variable = RUS_ic_time_60 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_total = RUS_ic_time_60 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_total < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_total = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_total > 3650 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_total = 3650 }
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_managed
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_running
	set_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_left = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_total }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_paid = 80 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_idea = RUS_disordered_industry_federal }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_paid = 64.0 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_variable = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_budget_current }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_paid = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_budget_current }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_trains = 10 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_last_day = global.num_days }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_available = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_paid }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_frozen = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_paid }
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = -10 }
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_goal_1
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_goal_2
	set_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_deadline = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_initial_days }
	RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_goals = yes
	RUS_np_refresh = yes
}
}
RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_goals = {

	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_running NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_goal_1 } 233 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } 233 = { check_variable = { resource@tungsten > 7 } } }
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_goal_1
}
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_goal_2 } 233 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } check_variable = { RUS_np_rail_region_3 > 1.499 } }
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_goal_2
}
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_goal_3 } 233 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } 233 = { NOT = { infrastructure < 3 } check_variable = { resource@tungsten > 7 } } }
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_goal_3
}
}

RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_timer = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_running has_variable = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_display = 0 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_left < 0.001 } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_display = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_display = RUS_np_speed }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_display = RUS_np_transport_duration_3 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_display = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_display
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_display < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_display = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_display > 7300 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_display = 7300 }
}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_display = 1 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_display }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_deadline = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_display }
	RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_apply_timer_delta = yes
}
}
RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_tick = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_running check_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_last_day < global.num_days } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_last_day = global.num_days }
	RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_goals = yes
	set_variable = { RUS_np_regional_work = RUS_np_speed }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_regional_work = RUS_np_transport_duration_3 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_left = RUS_np_regional_work }
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_left < 0 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_left = 0 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_left > RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_total } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_left = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_total }
}
}
}
RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_release = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_running }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_frozen = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_paid }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_available = RUS_np_refund }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_spent = RUS_np_consumed }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_trains }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 233 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.75 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_return_trains
}
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = RUS_np_return_trains }
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_running
	set_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_trains = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_paid = 0 }
	RUS_np_refresh = yes
	set_country_flag = RUS_rc_settled_RUS_tyrnyauz_tungsten
	clr_country_flag = RUS_rc_running_RUS_tyrnyauz_tungsten
}
}
RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_cancel = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_running }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_total }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_total }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_paid }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 233 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_loss = RUS_np_refund }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_loss = 0.5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_loss }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_loss }
}
	RUS_np_tyrnyauz_tungsten_release = yes
}
}

	divide_variable = { RUS_np_romanshkino_oil_display = RUS_np_speed }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_romanshkino_oil_display = RUS_np_transport_duration_3 }

	round_variable = RUS_np_romanshkino_oil_display
	if = {

	set_variable = { RUS_np_romanshkino_oil_display = 1 }

	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_romanshkino_oil_display > 7300 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_romanshkino_oil_display = 7300 }

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_romanshkino_oil_display = 1 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_romanshkino_oil_display }

RUS_np_romanshkino_oil_finish = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_romanshkino_oil_running }
	RUS_np_romanshkino_oil_tick = yes
	if = {
	limit = { 249 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } }
	RUS_np_romanshkino_oil_goals = yes

			log = "[GetLogRoot][GetLogFrom]: Decision remove RUS_romanshkino_oil"
			if = {
				limit = { has_idea = vostokneft_improved }
				249 = {
					add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
					if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1 } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
					add_resource = {
						type = oil
						amount = 24
					}
					if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_resource = {
						type = oil
						amount = 24
					} } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
				}
			}
			else = {
				249 = {
					add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
					if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1 } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
					add_resource = {
						type = oil
						amount = 20
					}
					if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_resource = {
						type = oil
						amount = 20
					} } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
				}
			}
			RUS_stalin_industry_effect = yes

 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_BEGIN
 hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = RUS_rc_finished_RUS_romanshkino_oil set_country_flag = RUS_rc_settled_RUS_romanshkino_oil clr_country_flag = RUS_rc_running_RUS_romanshkino_oil  }
 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_END

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 4 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_182 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 1 }
}
	RUS_np_flush_plan_score = yes
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_romanshkino_oil_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_romanshkino_oil_goal_1 }
	249 = {
	add_resource = { type = oil amount = 4 }
}
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_romanshkino_oil_goal_2 }
	249 = {
	if = {
	limit = { industrial_infrastructure < 5 }
	add_building_construction = { type = industrial_infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}
}
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_romanshkino_oil_completed
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_romanshkino_oil_paid }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_625 has_country_flag = RUS_np_romanshkino_oil_goal_1 has_country_flag = RUS_np_romanshkino_oil_goal_2 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.5 }
}
	else = {
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_romanshkino_oil_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	RUS_np_romanshkino_oil_release = yes
}
	else = {
	RUS_np_romanshkino_oil_cancel = yes
}
}

RUS_np_northern_route_timer = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_northern_route_running has_variable = RUS_np_northern_route_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_northern_route_display = 0 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_np_northern_route_left < 0.001 } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_northern_route_display = RUS_np_northern_route_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_northern_route_display = RUS_np_speed }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_northern_route_display = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_northern_route_display
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_northern_route_display < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_northern_route_display = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_northern_route_display > 7300 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_northern_route_display = 7300 }
}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_northern_route_display = 1 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_northern_route_display }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_northern_route_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_northern_route_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_northern_route_deadline = RUS_np_northern_route_display }
	RUS_np_northern_route_apply_timer_delta = yes
}
}
RUS_np_northern_route_tick = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_northern_route_running check_variable = { RUS_np_northern_route_last_day < global.num_days } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_northern_route_last_day = global.num_days }
	RUS_np_northern_route_goals = yes
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_northern_route_left = RUS_np_speed }
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_northern_route_left < 0 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_northern_route_left = 0 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_northern_route_left > RUS_np_northern_route_total } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_northern_route_left = RUS_np_northern_route_total }
}
}

RUS_np_northern_route_release = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_northern_route_running }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_frozen = RUS_np_northern_route_paid }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_available = RUS_np_refund }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_spent = RUS_np_consumed }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = RUS_np_northern_route_trains }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 400 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.75 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_return_trains
}
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = RUS_np_return_trains }
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_northern_route_running
	set_variable = { RUS_np_northern_route_trains = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_northern_route_paid = 0 }
	RUS_np_refresh = yes
	set_country_flag = RUS_rc_settled_RUS_northern_route
	clr_country_flag = RUS_rc_running_RUS_northern_route
}
}
RUS_np_northern_route_cancel = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_northern_route_running }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_northern_route_total }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_northern_route_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_northern_route_total }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_northern_route_paid }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_northern_route_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 400 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_loss = RUS_np_refund }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_loss = 0.5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_loss }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_loss }
}
	RUS_np_northern_route_release = yes
}

RUS_np_northern_route_finish = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_northern_route_running }
	RUS_np_northern_route_tick = yes
	if = {
	limit = { 400 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } }
	RUS_np_northern_route_goals = yes

			log = "[GetLogRoot][GetLogFrom]: Decision remove RUS_northern_route"
			set_country_flag = RUS_northern_route_completed
			add_stability = 0.03
			if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } add_stability = 0.03 } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
			build_railway = {
				level = 2
				start_province = 3215
				target_province = 1821
			}
			RUS_stalin_industry_effect = yes

			RUS_decrease_black_monday = yes
 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_BEGIN
 hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = RUS_rc_finished_RUS_northern_route set_country_flag = RUS_rc_settled_RUS_northern_route clr_country_flag = RUS_rc_running_RUS_northern_route  }
 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_END

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 2 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_182 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 1 }
}
	RUS_np_flush_plan_score = yes
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_northern_route_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_northern_route_goal_1 }
	400 = {
	hidden_effect = { if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }
} }
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_northern_route_goal_2 }
	400 = {
	if = {
	limit = { industrial_infrastructure < 5 }
	add_building_construction = { type = industrial_infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rail_northern = 2 }
	build_railway = { level = 2 path = { 3215 11250 3358 11282 6380 9378 9278 6356 252 121 9122 11099 2 9168 2996 11143 143 3135 9200 11075 73 3066 3103 6089 9214 6124 272 3139 3027 370 9293 12203 7346 11352 7375 11228 237 4758 12567 1821 } }
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_northern_route_completed
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_northern_route_paid }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_625 has_country_flag = RUS_np_northern_route_goal_1 has_country_flag = RUS_np_northern_route_goal_2 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.5 }
}
	else = {
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_northern_route_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	RUS_np_northern_route_release = yes
}
	else = {
	RUS_np_northern_route_cancel = yes
}
}

RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_timer = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_running has_variable = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_display = 0 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_left < 0.001 } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_display = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_display = RUS_np_speed }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_display = RUS_np_transport_duration_5 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_display = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_display
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_display < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_display = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_display > 7300 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_display = 7300 }
}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_display = 1 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_display }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_deadline = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_display }
	RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_apply_timer_delta = yes
}

RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_tick = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_running check_variable = { RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_last_day < global.num_days } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_last_day = global.num_days }
	RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_goals = yes
	set_variable = { RUS_np_regional_work = RUS_np_speed }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_regional_work = RUS_np_transport_duration_5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_left = RUS_np_regional_work }
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_left < 0 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_left = 0 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_left > RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_total } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_left = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_total }
}
}

RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_release = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_running }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_frozen = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_paid }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_available = RUS_np_refund }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_spent = RUS_np_consumed }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_trains }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 568 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.75 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_return_trains
}
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = RUS_np_return_trains }
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_running
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_cost }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_trains = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_paid = 0 }
	RUS_np_refresh = yes
	set_country_flag = RUS_rc_settled_RUS_krasnoyarskpromstroy
	clr_country_flag = RUS_rc_running_RUS_krasnoyarskpromstroy
}

RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_cancel = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_running }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_total }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_total }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_paid }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 568 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_loss = RUS_np_refund }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_loss = 0.5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_loss }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_loss }
}
	RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_release = yes
}
}
RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_finish = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_running }
	RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_tick = yes
	if = {
	limit = { 568 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } }
	RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_goals = yes

			log = "[GetLogRoot][GetLogFrom]: Decision remove RUS_krasnoyarskpromstroy"
			568 = {
				add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
				if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1 } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
				add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 }
				if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 } } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
				add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 }
				if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 } } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
			}
			RUS_stalin_industry_effect = yes

			add_to_variable = { RUS_siberian_decisions = 1 }
 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_BEGIN
 hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = RUS_rc_finished_RUS_krasnoyarskpromstroy set_country_flag = RUS_rc_settled_RUS_krasnoyarskpromstroy clr_country_flag = RUS_rc_running_RUS_krasnoyarskpromstroy  }
 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_END

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 2 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_182 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 1 }
}
	RUS_np_flush_plan_score = yes
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_goal_1 }
	568 = {
	hidden_effect = { if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }
} }
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_goal_2 }
	568 = {
	if = {
	limit = { industrial_infrastructure < 5 }
	add_building_construction = { type = industrial_infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}
}
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_completed
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_paid }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_625 has_country_flag = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_goal_1 has_country_flag = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_goal_2 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.5 }
}
	else = {
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_release = yes
}
	else = {
	RUS_np_krasnoyarskpromstroy_cancel = yes
}
}
}

RUS_np_dalnremmash_timer = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_dalnremmash_running has_variable = RUS_np_dalnremmash_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_dalnremmash_display = 0 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_np_dalnremmash_left < 0.001 } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_dalnremmash_display = RUS_np_dalnremmash_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_dalnremmash_display = RUS_np_speed }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_dalnremmash_display = RUS_np_transport_duration_5 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_dalnremmash_display = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_dalnremmash_display
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_dalnremmash_display < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_dalnremmash_display = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_dalnremmash_display > 7300 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_dalnremmash_display = 7300 }
}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_dalnremmash_display = 1 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_dalnremmash_display }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_dalnremmash_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_dalnremmash_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_dalnremmash_deadline = RUS_np_dalnremmash_display }
	RUS_np_dalnremmash_apply_timer_delta = yes
}
}
RUS_np_dalnremmash_tick = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_dalnremmash_running check_variable = { RUS_np_dalnremmash_last_day < global.num_days } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_dalnremmash_last_day = global.num_days }
	RUS_np_dalnremmash_goals = yes
	set_variable = { RUS_np_regional_work = RUS_np_speed }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_regional_work = RUS_np_transport_duration_5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_dalnremmash_left = RUS_np_regional_work }
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_dalnremmash_left < 0 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_dalnremmash_left = 0 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_dalnremmash_left > RUS_np_dalnremmash_total } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_dalnremmash_left = RUS_np_dalnremmash_total }
}
}

RUS_np_dalnremmash_release = {

	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_frozen = RUS_np_dalnremmash_paid }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_available = RUS_np_refund }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_spent = RUS_np_consumed }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = RUS_np_dalnremmash_trains }

	limit = { NOT = { 409 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }

	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.499 }

}
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = RUS_np_return_trains }
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_dalnremmash_running
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_dalnremmash_cost }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_dalnremmash_trains = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_dalnremmash_paid = 0 }
	RUS_np_refresh = yes
	set_country_flag = RUS_rc_settled_RUS_dalnremmash
	clr_country_flag = RUS_rc_running_RUS_dalnremmash
}
}
RUS_np_dalnremmash_cancel = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_dalnremmash_running }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_dalnremmash_total }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_dalnremmash_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_dalnremmash_total }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_dalnremmash_paid }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_dalnremmash_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 409 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_loss = RUS_np_refund }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_loss = 0.5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_loss }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_loss }
}
	RUS_np_dalnremmash_release = yes
}
}
RUS_np_dalnremmash_finish = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_dalnremmash_running }
	RUS_np_dalnremmash_tick = yes
	if = {
	limit = { 409 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } }
	RUS_np_dalnremmash_goals = yes

			log = "[GetLogRoot][GetLogFrom]: Decision remove RUS_dalnremmash"
			409 = {
				add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2
				if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
				add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 2 }
				if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 2 } } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
			}
			RUS_stalin_industry_effect = yes

			add_to_variable = { RUS_siberian_decisions = 1 }
 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_BEGIN
 hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = RUS_rc_finished_RUS_dalnremmash set_country_flag = RUS_rc_settled_RUS_dalnremmash clr_country_flag = RUS_rc_running_RUS_dalnremmash  }
 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_END

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 4 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_182 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 1 }
}
	RUS_np_flush_plan_score = yes
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_dalnremmash_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_dalnremmash_goal_1 }
	409 = {
	hidden_effect = { if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }
} }
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_dalnremmash_goal_2 }
	409 = {
	if = {
	limit = { industrial_infrastructure < 5 }
	add_building_construction = { type = industrial_infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}
}
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_dalnremmash_completed
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_dalnremmash_paid }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_625 has_country_flag = RUS_np_dalnremmash_goal_1 has_country_flag = RUS_np_dalnremmash_goal_2 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.5 }
}
	else = {
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_dalnremmash_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	RUS_np_dalnremmash_release = yes
}
	else = {
	RUS_np_dalnremmash_cancel = yes
}
}
}
