RUS_np_rudny_altay_timer = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_rudny_altay_running has_variable = RUS_np_rudny_altay_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rudny_altay_display = 0 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_np_rudny_altay_left < 0.001 } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rudny_altay_display = RUS_np_rudny_altay_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_rudny_altay_display = RUS_np_speed }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_rudny_altay_display = RUS_np_transport_duration_6 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_rudny_altay_display = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_rudny_altay_display
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_rudny_altay_display < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rudny_altay_display = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_rudny_altay_display > 7300 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rudny_altay_display = 7300 }
}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_rudny_altay_display = 1 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_rudny_altay_display }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_rudny_altay_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rudny_altay_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_rudny_altay_deadline = RUS_np_rudny_altay_display }
	RUS_np_rudny_altay_apply_timer_delta = yes
}
}
RUS_np_rudny_altay_tick = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_rudny_altay_running check_variable = { RUS_np_rudny_altay_last_day < global.num_days } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rudny_altay_last_day = global.num_days }
	RUS_np_rudny_altay_goals = yes
	set_variable = { RUS_np_regional_work = RUS_np_speed }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_regional_work = RUS_np_transport_duration_6 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_rudny_altay_left = RUS_np_regional_work }
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_rudny_altay_left < 0 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rudny_altay_left = 0 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_rudny_altay_left > RUS_np_rudny_altay_total } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rudny_altay_left = RUS_np_rudny_altay_total }
}
}
}
RUS_np_rudny_altay_release = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_rudny_altay_running }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_frozen = RUS_np_rudny_altay_paid }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_available = RUS_np_refund }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_spent = RUS_np_consumed }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = RUS_np_rudny_altay_trains }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 810 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.75 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_return_trains
}
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = RUS_np_return_trains }
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_rudny_altay_running
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rudny_altay_trains = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_rudny_altay_paid = 0 }
	RUS_np_refresh = yes
	set_country_flag = RUS_rc_settled_RUS_rudny_altay
	clr_country_flag = RUS_rc_running_RUS_rudny_altay
}
}
RUS_np_rudny_altay_cancel = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_rudny_altay_running }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_rudny_altay_total }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_rudny_altay_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_rudny_altay_total }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_rudny_altay_paid }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_rudny_altay_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 810 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_loss = RUS_np_refund }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_loss = 0.5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_loss }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_loss }
}
	RUS_np_rudny_altay_release = yes
}
}
RUS_np_rudny_altay_finish = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_rudny_altay_running }
	RUS_np_rudny_altay_tick = yes
	if = {
	limit = { 810 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } }
	RUS_np_rudny_altay_goals = yes

			log = "[GetLogRoot][GetLogFrom]: Decision remove RUS_rudny_altay"
			add_resource = {
				type = steel
				amount = 42
				state = 810
			}
			if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_resource = {
				type = steel
				amount = 42
				state = 810
			} } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
			add_resource = {
				type = aluminium
				amount = 12
				state = 810
			}
			if = { limit = { hidden_trigger = { owner = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no } } } add_resource = {
				type = aluminium
				amount = 12
				state = 810
			} } # RUS_EASY_MODE_REWARD
			RUS_stalin_industry_effect = yes

 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_BEGIN
 hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = RUS_rc_finished_RUS_rudny_altay set_country_flag = RUS_rc_settled_RUS_rudny_altay clr_country_flag = RUS_rc_running_RUS_rudny_altay  }
 # RUS_RECOVERY_LEDGER_END

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 4 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_182 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 1 }
}
	RUS_np_flush_plan_score = yes
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_rudny_altay_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_rudny_altay_goal_1 }
	810 = {
	add_resource = { type = aluminium amount = 4 }
}
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_rudny_altay_goal_2 }
	810 = {
	if = {
	limit = { industrial_infrastructure < 5 }
	add_building_construction = { type = industrial_infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}
}
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_rudny_altay_completed
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_rudny_altay_paid }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_625 has_country_flag = RUS_np_rudny_altay_goal_1 has_country_flag = RUS_np_rudny_altay_goal_2 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.5 }
}
	else = {
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_rudny_altay_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	RUS_np_rudny_altay_release = yes
}
	else = {
	RUS_np_rudny_altay_cancel = yes
}
}
}

RUS_np_gaz_timer = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_gaz_running has_variable = RUS_np_gaz_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_gaz_display = 0 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_np_gaz_left < 0.001 } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_gaz_display = RUS_np_gaz_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_gaz_display = RUS_np_speed }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_gaz_display = RUS_np_transport_duration_1 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_gaz_display = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_gaz_display
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_gaz_display < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_gaz_display = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_gaz_display > 7300 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_gaz_display = 7300 }
}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_gaz_display = 1 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_gaz_display }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_gaz_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_gaz_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_gaz_deadline = RUS_np_gaz_display }
	RUS_np_gaz_apply_timer_delta = yes
}
}
RUS_np_gaz_tick = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_gaz_running check_variable = { RUS_np_gaz_last_day < global.num_days } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_gaz_last_day = global.num_days }
	RUS_np_gaz_goals = yes
	set_variable = { RUS_np_regional_work = RUS_np_speed }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_regional_work = RUS_np_transport_duration_1 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_gaz_left = RUS_np_regional_work }
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_gaz_left < 0 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_gaz_left = 0 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_gaz_left > RUS_np_gaz_total } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_gaz_left = RUS_np_gaz_total }
}
}
}
RUS_np_gaz_release = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_gaz_running }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_frozen = RUS_np_gaz_paid }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_available = RUS_np_refund }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_spent = RUS_np_consumed }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = RUS_np_gaz_trains }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 252 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.75 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_return_trains
}
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = RUS_np_return_trains }
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_gaz_running
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_gaz_cost }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_gaz_trains = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_gaz_paid = 0 }
	RUS_np_refresh = yes
}
}
RUS_np_gaz_cancel = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_gaz_running }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_gaz_total }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_gaz_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_gaz_total }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_gaz_paid }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_gaz_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 252 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_loss = RUS_np_refund }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_loss = 0.5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_loss }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_loss }
}
	RUS_np_gaz_release = yes
}
}
RUS_np_gaz_finish = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_gaz_running }
	RUS_np_gaz_tick = yes
	if = {
	limit = { 252 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } }
	RUS_np_gaz_goals = yes

	252 = {
	if = {
	limit = { industrial_complex < 20 }
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
	add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 2 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_182 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 1 }
}
	RUS_np_flush_plan_score = yes
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_gaz_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_gaz_goal_1 }
	252 = {
	hidden_effect = { if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }
} }
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}
	add_offsite_building = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_gaz_goal_2 }
	252 = {
	if = {
	limit = { industrial_infrastructure < 5 }
	add_building_construction = { type = industrial_infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}
}
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_gaz_completed
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_gaz_paid }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_625 has_country_flag = RUS_np_gaz_goal_1 has_country_flag = RUS_np_gaz_goal_2 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.5 }
}
	else = {
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_gaz_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	RUS_np_gaz_release = yes
}
	else = {
	RUS_np_gaz_cancel = yes
}
}
}

RUS_np_bearing_timer = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_bearing_running has_variable = RUS_np_bearing_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_bearing_display = 0 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_np_bearing_left < 0.001 } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_bearing_display = RUS_np_bearing_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_bearing_display = RUS_np_speed }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_bearing_display = RUS_np_transport_duration_1 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_bearing_display = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_bearing_display
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_bearing_display < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_bearing_display = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_bearing_display > 7300 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_bearing_display = 7300 }
}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_bearing_display = 1 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_bearing_display }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_bearing_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_bearing_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_bearing_deadline = RUS_np_bearing_display }
	RUS_np_bearing_apply_timer_delta = yes
}

RUS_np_bearing_tick = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_bearing_running check_variable = { RUS_np_bearing_last_day < global.num_days } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_bearing_last_day = global.num_days }
	RUS_np_bearing_goals = yes
	set_variable = { RUS_np_regional_work = RUS_np_speed }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_regional_work = RUS_np_transport_duration_1 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_bearing_left = RUS_np_regional_work }
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_bearing_left < 0 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_bearing_left = 0 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_bearing_left > RUS_np_bearing_total } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_bearing_left = RUS_np_bearing_total }
}
}
}
RUS_np_bearing_release = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_bearing_running }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_frozen = RUS_np_bearing_paid }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_available = RUS_np_refund }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_spent = RUS_np_consumed }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = RUS_np_bearing_trains }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 219 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.75 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_return_trains
}
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = RUS_np_return_trains }
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_bearing_running
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_bearing_cost }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_bearing_trains = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_bearing_paid = 0 }
	RUS_np_refresh = yes
}

RUS_np_bearing_cancel = {

	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_bearing_total }

	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_bearing_paid }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_bearing_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }

	limit = { NOT = { 219 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_loss = RUS_np_refund }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_loss = 0.5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_loss }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_loss }
}
	RUS_np_bearing_release = yes
}

RUS_np_bearing_finish = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_bearing_running }
	RUS_np_bearing_tick = yes
	if = {
	limit = { 219 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } }
	RUS_np_bearing_goals = yes

	219 = {
	if = {
	limit = { industrial_complex < 20 }
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
	add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 2 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_182 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 1 }
}
	RUS_np_flush_plan_score = yes
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_bearing_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_bearing_goal_1 }
	RUS_np_award_education = yes
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_bearing_goal_2 }
	219 = {
	if = {
	limit = { industrial_infrastructure < 5 }
	add_building_construction = { type = industrial_infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}
}
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_bearing_completed
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_bearing_paid }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_625 has_country_flag = RUS_np_bearing_goal_1 has_country_flag = RUS_np_bearing_goal_2 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.5 }
}
	else = {
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_bearing_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	RUS_np_bearing_release = yes
}
	else = {
	RUS_np_bearing_cancel = yes
}
}

RUS_np_kashira_begin = {
	if = {
	limit = { RUS_np_ready_kashira = yes }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_kashira_total = 180 }
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_kashira_total < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_kashira_total = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_kashira_total > 3650 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_kashira_total = 3650 }
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_kashira_managed
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_kashira_running
	set_variable = { RUS_np_kashira_left = RUS_np_kashira_total }

	limit = { has_idea = RUS_disordered_industry_federal }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_kashira_paid = 112.0 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_variable = RUS_np_kashira_budget_current }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_kashira_paid = RUS_np_kashira_budget_current }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_kashira_trains = 10 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_kashira_last_day = global.num_days }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_available = RUS_np_kashira_paid }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_frozen = RUS_np_kashira_paid }
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = -10 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_kashira_cost }
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_kashira_goal_1
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_kashira_goal_2
	set_variable = { RUS_np_kashira_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_kashira_deadline = RUS_np_kashira_initial_days }

	RUS_np_refresh = yes

	set_country_flag = RUS_np_kashira_goal_1

	set_country_flag = RUS_np_kashira_goal_2
}
}

	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_kashira_goal_1 }
	219 = {
	hidden_effect = { if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }
} }
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_kashira_goal_2 }
	219 = {
	if = {
	limit = { industrial_infrastructure < 5 }
	add_building_construction = { type = industrial_infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}
}

RUS_np_moscow_grid_timer = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_grid_running has_variable = RUS_np_moscow_grid_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_grid_display = 0 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_grid_left < 0.001 } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_grid_display = RUS_np_moscow_grid_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_grid_display = RUS_np_speed }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_grid_display = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_moscow_grid_display
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_grid_display < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_grid_display = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_grid_display > 7300 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_grid_display = 7300 }
}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_grid_display = 1 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_moscow_grid_display }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_moscow_grid_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_grid_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_grid_deadline = RUS_np_moscow_grid_display }
	RUS_np_moscow_grid_apply_timer_delta = yes
}
}
RUS_np_moscow_grid_tick = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_grid_running check_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_grid_last_day < global.num_days } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_grid_last_day = global.num_days }
	RUS_np_moscow_grid_goals = yes
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_grid_left = RUS_np_speed }
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_grid_left < 0 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_grid_left = 0 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_grid_left > RUS_np_moscow_grid_total } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_grid_left = RUS_np_moscow_grid_total }
}
}
}
RUS_np_moscow_grid_release = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_grid_running }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_frozen = RUS_np_moscow_grid_paid }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_available = RUS_np_refund }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_spent = RUS_np_consumed }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = RUS_np_moscow_grid_trains }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 219 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.75 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_return_trains
}
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = RUS_np_return_trains }
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_grid_running
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_moscow_grid_cost }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_grid_trains = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_grid_paid = 0 }
	RUS_np_refresh = yes
}
}
RUS_np_moscow_grid_cancel = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_grid_running }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_moscow_grid_total }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_moscow_grid_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_moscow_grid_total }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_moscow_grid_paid }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_moscow_grid_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 219 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_loss = RUS_np_refund }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_loss = 0.5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_loss }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_loss }
}
	RUS_np_moscow_grid_release = yes
}
}
RUS_np_moscow_grid_finish = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_grid_running }
	RUS_np_moscow_grid_tick = yes
	if = {
	limit = { 219 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } }
	RUS_np_moscow_grid_goals = yes

	219 = {
	if = {
	limit = { infrastructure < 5 }
	add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 2 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_182 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 1 }
}
	RUS_np_flush_plan_score = yes
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_grid_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_grid_goal_1 }
	219 = {
	hidden_effect = { if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }
} }
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_grid_goal_2 }
	219 = {
	if = {
	limit = { industrial_infrastructure < 5 }
	add_building_construction = { type = industrial_infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}
}
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_grid_completed
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_moscow_grid_paid }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_625 has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_grid_goal_1 has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_grid_goal_2 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.5 }
}
	else = {
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_moscow_grid_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	RUS_np_moscow_grid_release = yes
}
	else = {
	RUS_np_moscow_grid_cancel = yes
}
}
}

RUS_np_metro_timer = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_metro_running has_variable = RUS_np_metro_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_metro_display = 0 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_np_metro_left < 0.001 } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_metro_display = RUS_np_metro_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_metro_display = RUS_np_speed }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_metro_display = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_metro_display
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_metro_display < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_metro_display = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_metro_display > 7300 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_metro_display = 7300 }
}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_metro_display = 1 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_metro_display }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_metro_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_metro_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_metro_deadline = RUS_np_metro_display }
	RUS_np_metro_apply_timer_delta = yes
}
}
RUS_np_metro_tick = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_metro_running check_variable = { RUS_np_metro_last_day < global.num_days } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_metro_last_day = global.num_days }
	RUS_np_metro_goals = yes
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_metro_left = RUS_np_speed }
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_metro_left < 0 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_metro_left = 0 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_metro_left > RUS_np_metro_total } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_metro_left = RUS_np_metro_total }
}
}
}
RUS_np_metro_release = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_metro_running }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_frozen = RUS_np_metro_paid }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_available = RUS_np_refund }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_spent = RUS_np_consumed }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = RUS_np_metro_trains }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 219 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.75 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_return_trains
}
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = RUS_np_return_trains }
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_metro_running
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_metro_cost }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_metro_trains = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_metro_paid = 0 }
	RUS_np_refresh = yes
}
}
RUS_np_metro_cancel = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_metro_running }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_metro_total }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_metro_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_metro_total }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_metro_paid }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_metro_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 219 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_loss = RUS_np_refund }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_loss = 0.5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_loss }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_loss }
}
	RUS_np_metro_release = yes
}
}
RUS_np_metro_finish = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_metro_running }
	RUS_np_metro_tick = yes
	if = {
	limit = { 219 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } }
	RUS_np_metro_goals = yes

	219 = {
	if = {
	limit = { infrastructure < 5 }
	add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}
	219 = {
	add_manpower = 5000
}
	219 = {
	hidden_effect = { if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }
} }
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 2 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_182 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 1 }
}
	RUS_np_flush_plan_score = yes
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_metro_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_metro_goal_1 }
	219 = {
	hidden_effect = { if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }
} }
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_metro_goal_2 }
	219 = {
	add_manpower = 5000
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_metro_completed
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_metro_paid }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_625 has_country_flag = RUS_np_metro_goal_1 has_country_flag = RUS_np_metro_goal_2 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.5 }
}
	else = {
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_metro_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	RUS_np_metro_release = yes
}
	else = {
	RUS_np_metro_cancel = yes
}
}
}

RUS_np_moscow_volga_tick = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_volga_running check_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_volga_last_day < global.num_days } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_volga_last_day = global.num_days }
	RUS_np_moscow_volga_goals = yes
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_volga_left = RUS_np_speed }
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_volga_left < 0 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_volga_left = 0 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_volga_left > RUS_np_moscow_volga_total } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_volga_left = RUS_np_moscow_volga_total }
}
}
}
RUS_np_moscow_volga_release = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_volga_running }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_frozen = RUS_np_moscow_volga_paid }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_available = RUS_np_refund }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_spent = RUS_np_consumed }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = RUS_np_moscow_volga_trains }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 247 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.75 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_return_trains
}
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = RUS_np_return_trains }
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_volga_running
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_moscow_volga_cost }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_volga_trains = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_volga_paid = 0 }
	RUS_np_refresh = yes
}
}
RUS_np_moscow_volga_cancel = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_volga_running }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_moscow_volga_total }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_moscow_volga_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_moscow_volga_total }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_moscow_volga_paid }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_moscow_volga_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 247 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_loss = RUS_np_refund }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_loss = 0.5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_loss }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_loss }
}
	RUS_np_moscow_volga_release = yes
}
}
RUS_np_moscow_volga_finish = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_volga_running }
	RUS_np_moscow_volga_tick = yes
	if = {
	limit = { 247 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } }
	RUS_np_moscow_volga_goals = yes

	247 = {
	if = {
	limit = { infrastructure < 5 }
	add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}
	247 = {
	add_manpower = 5000
}
	247 = {
	hidden_effect = { if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }
} }
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 2 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_182 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 1 }
}
	RUS_np_flush_plan_score = yes
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_volga_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_volga_goal_1 }
	247 = {
	hidden_effect = { if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }
} }
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_volga_goal_2 }
	247 = {
	if = {
	limit = { industrial_infrastructure < 5 }
	add_building_construction = { type = industrial_infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}
}
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_volga_completed
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_moscow_volga_paid }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_625 has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_volga_goal_1 has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_volga_goal_2 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.5 }
}
	else = {
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_moscow_volga_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	RUS_np_moscow_volga_release = yes
}
	else = {
	RUS_np_moscow_volga_cancel = yes
}
}
}
RUS_np_svir_begin = {
	if = {
	limit = { RUS_np_ready_svir = yes }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_svir_total = 365 }
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_svir_total < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_svir_total = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_svir_total > 3650 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_svir_total = 3650 }
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_svir_managed
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_svir_running
	set_variable = { RUS_np_svir_left = RUS_np_svir_total }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_svir_paid = 220 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_idea = RUS_disordered_industry_federal }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_svir_paid = 176.0 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_variable = RUS_np_svir_budget_current }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_svir_paid = RUS_np_svir_budget_current }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_svir_trains = 10 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_svir_last_day = global.num_days }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_available = RUS_np_svir_paid }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_frozen = RUS_np_svir_paid }
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = -10 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_svir_cost }
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_svir_goal_1
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_svir_goal_2
	set_variable = { RUS_np_svir_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_svir_deadline = RUS_np_svir_initial_days }
	RUS_np_svir_goals = yes
	RUS_np_refresh = yes
}
}
RUS_np_svir_goals = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_svir_running NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_svir_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_svir_goal_1 } 216 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } 216 = { NOT = { infrastructure < 3 } } }
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_svir_goal_1
}
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_svir_goal_2 } 216 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } check_variable = { RUS_np_rail_region_2 > 1.499 } }
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_svir_goal_2
}
}
}

RUS_np_svir_timer = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_svir_running has_variable = RUS_np_svir_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_svir_display = 0 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_np_svir_left < 0.001 } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_svir_display = RUS_np_svir_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_svir_display = RUS_np_speed }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_svir_display = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_svir_display
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_svir_display < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_svir_display = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_svir_display > 7300 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_svir_display = 7300 }
}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_svir_display = 1 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_svir_display }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_svir_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_svir_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_svir_deadline = RUS_np_svir_display }
	RUS_np_svir_apply_timer_delta = yes
}
}

RUS_np_volkhov_timer = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_volkhov_running has_variable = RUS_np_volkhov_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_volkhov_display = 0 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_np_volkhov_left < 0.001 } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_volkhov_display = RUS_np_volkhov_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_volkhov_display = RUS_np_speed }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_volkhov_display = RUS_np_transport_duration_2 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_volkhov_display = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_volkhov_display
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_volkhov_display < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_volkhov_display = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_volkhov_display > 7300 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_volkhov_display = 7300 }
}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_volkhov_display = 1 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_volkhov_display }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_volkhov_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_volkhov_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_volkhov_deadline = RUS_np_volkhov_display }
	RUS_np_volkhov_apply_timer_delta = yes
}
}
RUS_np_volkhov_tick = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_volkhov_running check_variable = { RUS_np_volkhov_last_day < global.num_days } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_volkhov_last_day = global.num_days }
	RUS_np_volkhov_goals = yes
	set_variable = { RUS_np_regional_work = RUS_np_speed }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_regional_work = RUS_np_transport_duration_2 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_volkhov_left = RUS_np_regional_work }
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_volkhov_left < 0 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_volkhov_left = 0 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_volkhov_left > RUS_np_volkhov_total } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_volkhov_left = RUS_np_volkhov_total }
}
}

RUS_np_volkhov_release = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_volkhov_running }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_frozen = RUS_np_volkhov_paid }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_available = RUS_np_refund }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_spent = RUS_np_consumed }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = RUS_np_volkhov_trains }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 264 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.75 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_return_trains
}
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = RUS_np_return_trains }
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_volkhov_running
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_volkhov_cost }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_volkhov_trains = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_volkhov_paid = 0 }
	RUS_np_refresh = yes
}
}
RUS_np_volkhov_cancel = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_volkhov_running }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_volkhov_total }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_volkhov_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_volkhov_total }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_volkhov_paid }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_volkhov_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 264 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_loss = RUS_np_refund }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_loss = 0.5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_loss }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_loss }
}
	RUS_np_volkhov_release = yes
}
}
RUS_np_volkhov_finish = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_volkhov_running }
	RUS_np_volkhov_tick = yes
	if = {
	limit = { 264 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } }
	RUS_np_volkhov_goals = yes

	264 = {
	if = {
	limit = { industrial_complex < 20 }
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
	add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}
	264 = {
	add_resource = { type = aluminium amount = 8 }
}

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 2 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_182 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 1 }
}
	RUS_np_flush_plan_score = yes
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_volkhov_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_volkhov_goal_1 }
	264 = {
	hidden_effect = { if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }
} }
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_volkhov_goal_2 }
	264 = {
	if = {
	limit = { industrial_infrastructure < 5 }
	add_building_construction = { type = industrial_infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}
	RUS_np_award_mio_consortium = yes
}
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_volkhov_completed
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_volkhov_paid }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_625 has_country_flag = RUS_np_volkhov_goal_1 has_country_flag = RUS_np_volkhov_goal_2 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.5 }
}
	else = {
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_volkhov_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	RUS_np_volkhov_release = yes
}
	else = {
	RUS_np_volkhov_cancel = yes
}
}
}

RUS_np_uvz_timer = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_uvz_running has_variable = RUS_np_uvz_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_uvz_display = 0 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_np_uvz_left < 0.001 } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_uvz_display = RUS_np_uvz_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_uvz_display = RUS_np_speed }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_uvz_display = RUS_np_transport_duration_4 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_uvz_display = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_uvz_display
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_uvz_display < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_uvz_display = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_uvz_display > 7300 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_uvz_display = 7300 }
}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_uvz_display = 1 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_uvz_display }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_uvz_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_uvz_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_uvz_deadline = RUS_np_uvz_display }
	RUS_np_uvz_apply_timer_delta = yes
}
}
RUS_np_uvz_tick = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_uvz_running check_variable = { RUS_np_uvz_last_day < global.num_days } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_uvz_last_day = global.num_days }
	RUS_np_uvz_goals = yes
	set_variable = { RUS_np_regional_work = RUS_np_speed }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_regional_work = RUS_np_transport_duration_4 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_uvz_left = RUS_np_regional_work }
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_uvz_left < 0 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_uvz_left = 0 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_uvz_left > RUS_np_uvz_total } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_uvz_left = RUS_np_uvz_total }
}
}
}
RUS_np_uvz_release = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_uvz_running }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_frozen = RUS_np_uvz_paid }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_available = RUS_np_refund }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_spent = RUS_np_consumed }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = RUS_np_uvz_trains }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 653 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.75 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_return_trains
}
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = RUS_np_return_trains }
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_uvz_running
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_uvz_cost }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_uvz_trains = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_uvz_paid = 0 }
	RUS_np_refresh = yes
}
}
RUS_np_uvz_cancel = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_uvz_running }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_uvz_total }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_uvz_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_uvz_total }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_uvz_paid }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_uvz_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 653 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_loss = RUS_np_refund }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_loss = 0.5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_loss }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_loss }
}
	RUS_np_uvz_release = yes
}
}
RUS_np_uvz_finish = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_uvz_running }
	RUS_np_uvz_tick = yes
	if = {
	limit = { 653 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } }
	RUS_np_uvz_goals = yes

	653 = {
	if = {
	limit = { industrial_complex < 20 }
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
	add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = 10 }

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 2 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_182 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 1 }
}
	RUS_np_flush_plan_score = yes
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_uvz_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_uvz_goal_1 }
	RUS_np_award_education = yes
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_uvz_goal_2 }
	653 = {
	if = {
	limit = { industrial_infrastructure < 5 }
	add_building_construction = { type = industrial_infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}
	add_offsite_building = { type = arms_factory level = 1 }
}
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_uvz_completed
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_uvz_paid }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_625 has_country_flag = RUS_np_uvz_goal_1 has_country_flag = RUS_np_uvz_goal_2 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.5 }
}
	else = {
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_uvz_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	RUS_np_uvz_release = yes
}
	else = {
	RUS_np_uvz_cancel = yes
}
}
}

RUS_np_moscow_logistics_timer = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_logistics_running has_variable = RUS_np_moscow_logistics_deadline }

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_logistics_display = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_moscow_logistics_display

	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_logistics_display = 1 }

	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_logistics_display > 7300 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_logistics_display = 7300 }
}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_logistics_display = 1 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_moscow_logistics_display }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_moscow_logistics_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_logistics_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_logistics_deadline = RUS_np_moscow_logistics_display }

}

	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_total = 120 }
	if = {

	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_total = 1 }

	if = {

	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_total = 3650 }

	set_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_rural_running
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_left = RUS_np_moscow_rural_total }

}

	limit = { has_variable = RUS_np_moscow_rural_budget_current }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_paid = RUS_np_moscow_rural_budget_current }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_trains = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_last_day = global.num_days }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_available = RUS_np_moscow_rural_paid }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_frozen = RUS_np_moscow_rural_paid }
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = 0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_moscow_rural_cost }
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_rural_goal_1
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_rural_goal_2
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_deadline = RUS_np_moscow_rural_initial_days }
	RUS_np_moscow_rural_goals = yes
	RUS_np_refresh = yes
}

	set_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_rural_goal_1

	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_rural_goal_2 } 219 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } has_country_flag = RUS_nat_enabled check_variable = { RUS_nat_machine_stock > 99 } }
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_rural_goal_2
}
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_rural_goal_3 } 219 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } 219 = { NOT = { infrastructure < 3 } } has_country_flag = RUS_education_system_active }
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_rural_goal_3
}
}

RUS_np_moscow_rural_timer = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_rural_running has_variable = RUS_np_moscow_rural_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_display = 0 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_left < 0.001 } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_display = RUS_np_moscow_rural_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_display = RUS_np_speed }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_display = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_moscow_rural_display
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_display < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_display = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_display > 7300 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_display = 7300 }
}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_display = 1 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_moscow_rural_display }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_moscow_rural_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_deadline = RUS_np_moscow_rural_display }
	RUS_np_moscow_rural_apply_timer_delta = yes
}
}
RUS_np_moscow_rural_tick = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_rural_running check_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_last_day < global.num_days } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_last_day = global.num_days }
	RUS_np_moscow_rural_goals = yes
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_left = RUS_np_speed }
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_left < 0 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_left = 0 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_left > RUS_np_moscow_rural_total } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_left = RUS_np_moscow_rural_total }
}
}
}
RUS_np_moscow_rural_release = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_rural_running }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_frozen = RUS_np_moscow_rural_paid }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_available = RUS_np_refund }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_spent = RUS_np_consumed }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = RUS_np_moscow_rural_trains }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 219 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.75 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_return_trains
}
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = RUS_np_return_trains }
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_rural_running
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_moscow_rural_cost }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_trains = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_paid = 0 }
	RUS_np_refresh = yes
}
}
RUS_np_moscow_rural_cancel = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_rural_running }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_moscow_rural_total }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_moscow_rural_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_moscow_rural_total }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_moscow_rural_paid }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_moscow_rural_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 219 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_loss = RUS_np_refund }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_loss = 0.5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_loss }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_loss }
}
	RUS_np_moscow_rural_release = yes
}
}
RUS_np_moscow_rural_finish = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_rural_running }
	RUS_np_moscow_rural_tick = yes
	if = {
	limit = { 219 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } }
	RUS_np_moscow_rural_goals = yes

	custom_effect_tooltip = RUS_np_rural_reward_tt
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_moscow_rural_farm_rate = 2 } }
	219 = {
	hidden_effect = { if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }
} }
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 2 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_182 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 1 }
}
	RUS_np_flush_plan_score = yes
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_rural_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_rural_goal_1 }
	219 = {
	hidden_effect = { if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }
} }
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_rural_goal_2 }
	custom_effect_tooltip = RUS_np_farm_credit_tt
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { RUS_np_farm_credit = 100 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_rural_goal_3 }
	RUS_np_award_education = yes
}
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_rural_completed
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_moscow_rural_paid }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_625 has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_rural_goal_1 has_country_flag = RUS_np_moscow_rural_goal_2 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.5 }
}
	else = {
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_moscow_rural_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	RUS_np_moscow_rural_release = yes
}
	else = {
	RUS_np_moscow_rural_cancel = yes
}
}
}

RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_timer = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_running has_variable = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_display = 0 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_left < 0.001 } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_display = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_display = RUS_np_speed }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_display = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_display
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_display < 1 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_display = 1 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_display > 7300 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_display = 7300 }
}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_display = 1 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_display }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_adjust = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_deadline }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_deadline = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_deadline = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_display }
	RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_apply_timer_delta = yes
}
}
RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_tick = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_running check_variable = { RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_last_day < global.num_days } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_last_day = global.num_days }
	RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_goals = yes
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_left = RUS_np_speed }
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_left < 0 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_left = 0 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_left > RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_total } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_left = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_total }
}
}
}
RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_release = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_running }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_frozen = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_paid }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_available = RUS_np_refund }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_spent = RUS_np_consumed }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_trains }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 195 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.75 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.499 }
	round_variable = RUS_np_return_trains
}
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = RUS_np_return_trains }
	clr_country_flag = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_running
	set_variable = { RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_trains = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_paid = 0 }
	RUS_np_refresh = yes
}
}
RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_cancel = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_running }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_total }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_left }
	divide_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_total }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_paid }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { 195 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_loss = RUS_np_refund }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_loss = 0.5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_loss }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_loss }
}
	RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_release = yes
}
}
RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_finish = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_running }
	RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_tick = yes
	if = {
	limit = { 195 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } }
	RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_goals = yes

	195 = {
	if = {
	limit = { infrastructure < 5 }
	add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}
	hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_hub }
	195 = {
	hidden_effect = { if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }
} }
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}
	build_railway = { level = 2 path = { 6380 11282 3358 11250 3215 11315 2999 187 9111 6086 6035 6095 9164 11068 79 6174 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_rail_leningrad_core = 2 } }

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 2 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_182 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 1 }
}
	RUS_np_flush_plan_score = yes
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_goal_1 }
	195 = {
	hidden_effect = { if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }
} }
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_goal_2 }
	195 = {
	if = {
	limit = { industrial_infrastructure < 5 }
	add_building_construction = { type = industrial_infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}
	else = {
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}
}
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_goal_3 }
	RUS_np_award_resources = yes
}
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_completed
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_paid }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_625 has_country_flag = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_goal_1 has_country_flag = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_goal_2 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.5 }
}
	else = {
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_release = yes
}
	else = {
	RUS_np_leningrad_logistics_cancel = yes
}
}

	limit = { NOT = { 195 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes } } }

	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_return_trains = 0.499 }

	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }

	set_variable = { RUS_np_loss = RUS_np_refund }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_loss = 0.5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_loss }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_loss }
}
	RUS_np_leningrad_rural_release = yes
}

RUS_np_leningrad_rural_finish = {

	custom_effect_tooltip = RUS_np_rural_reward_tt
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_leningrad_rural_farm_rate = 2 } }
	195 = {

	limit = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }
} }
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 2 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_182 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 1 }
}
	RUS_np_flush_plan_score = yes
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_leningrad_rural_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_leningrad_rural_goal_1 }
	195 = {
	hidden_effect = { if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }
} }
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_leningrad_rural_goal_2 }
	custom_effect_tooltip = RUS_np_farm_credit_tt
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { RUS_np_farm_credit = 100 } }
}
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_leningrad_rural_completed
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_leningrad_rural_paid }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_625 has_country_flag = RUS_np_leningrad_rural_goal_1 has_country_flag = RUS_np_leningrad_rural_goal_2 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.5 }
}
	else = {

}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_leningrad_rural_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	RUS_np_leningrad_rural_release = yes
}
	else = {
	RUS_np_leningrad_rural_cancel = yes
}
}

	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}

	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 2 }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_182 }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_pending_plan_score = 1 }
}
	RUS_np_flush_plan_score = yes
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_tsaritsyn_rural_completed } }
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_tsaritsyn_rural_goal_1 }
	217 = {
	hidden_effect = { if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 }
} }
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = RUS_np_development } check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } } } }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 3 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 2 } }
}
	if = {
	limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = RUS_np_development check_variable = { RUS_np_development = 0 } } }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_np_region_1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { RUS_np_development = 1 } }
}
}
}
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_tsaritsyn_rural_goal_2 }
	custom_effect_tooltip = RUS_np_farm_credit_tt
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { RUS_np_farm_credit = 100 } }
	RUS_np_award_land_score = yes
}
}
	set_country_flag = RUS_np_tsaritsyn_rural_completed
	set_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = RUS_np_tsaritsyn_rural_paid }
	if = {
	limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_625 has_country_flag = RUS_np_tsaritsyn_rural_goal_1 has_country_flag = RUS_np_tsaritsyn_rural_goal_2 }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.5 }
}
	else = {
	multiply_variable = { RUS_np_consumed = 0.8 }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_tsaritsyn_rural_paid }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_refund = RUS_np_consumed }
	RUS_np_tsaritsyn_rural_release = yes
}
	else = {
	RUS_np_tsaritsyn_rural_cancel = yes
}
}
}
RUS_np_agri_delivery = {
	if = {
	limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_np_initialized check_variable = { RUS_np_agri_day < global.num_days } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_agri_day = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_delivery = RUS_np_farm_rate }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_delivery = RUS_np_farm_credit }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_room = RUS_nat_target }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_room = RUS_nat_installed }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_np_room = 5000 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_room = RUS_nat_machine_stock }
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_room < 0 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_room = 0 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_room > 1001000 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_room = 1001000 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_delivery < 0 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_delivery = 0 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_delivery > RUS_np_room } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_delivery = RUS_np_room }
}
	set_variable = { RUS_np_credit_used = RUS_np_delivery }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_credit_used = RUS_np_farm_rate }
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_credit_used < 0 } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_credit_used = 0 }
}
	if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { RUS_np_credit_used > RUS_np_farm_credit } }
	set_variable = { RUS_np_credit_used = RUS_np_farm_credit }
}
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_np_farm_credit = RUS_np_credit_used }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_machine_stock = RUS_np_delivery }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_produced = RUS_np_delivery }
}
}
